summary: Parameters of b64encode: required input string, encoding (default utf-8), and urlsafe (2.19+).
questions: How do I produce URL-safe Base64 in Ansible?

answer_card.title: b64encode parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (required): string to encode
- `encoding`: defaults to `utf-8`
- `urlsafe` (default false, 2.19+): use `-` and `_` instead of `+` and `/`
